full_judgment: 20. There is yet another special feature of the case which has been overlooked by the learned Courts below. Admittedly the finally published RS Khatian stands in the name of the plaintiff and the Government is regularly accepting rent from him thereby recognising him as the tenant in respect of the suit land. A finally published record of rights revised under section 114A of the SAT Act has a presumption of correctness and that presumption continues till it is otherwise rebutted by reliable evidence. Nothing has been done by the contesting defendants to dispel the legal presumption that attaches to the finally published RS Khatian in the name of the plaintiff. Recognition of the plaintiff as a tenant in respect of the suit property by the Revenue Authority of the Government is binding upon the Vested Property Department and the latter cannot claim the suit land as a vested property summarily discarding the finally published RS Khatian in the name of the plaintiff. The action of the ADC (Revenue) Dhaka who is the de facto head of the Vested Property Department of the District indulging in oppressive litigations must be deprecated. The case of the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev) Narayanganj vs. AKM Latiful Karim and others reported in 17 BW (HCD) 249 lends instant support to this view. The impugned judgment cannot be sustainable on that ground as well.
